addons.name: DiceCloud v1
addons.description: D&D 5e characters from DiceCloud v1: paste a character's link, or upload a saved copy of its API JSON. A public sheet needs nothing more; a private one asks for your DiceCloud API key. Builds the character on the dnd-5e-2024 sheet.
addons.author: ianfhunter

addons.name: D&D Beyond
addons.description: D&D 5e characters from D&D Beyond: paste a character's link, or upload a saved copy of its JSON. The character must be shared publicly. Builds the character on the dnd-5e-2024 sheet.
addons.author: ianfhunter
